prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high overall, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign in round 6 and choose_path layout in round 7) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful and consistently positive across 5 tests, winning 2 tests.
Home wait_info changes (4 tests), adoption layout changes (3 tests), and choose_path redesign changes (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish redesign changes (3 tests) and finish new_screen changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for categories with only 1 test or conflicting outcomes (including home notification, choose_path layout, and sign_in redesign).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout for Custom Pet Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a carousel layout and live animated mascot component to streamline character selection. (why: Adoption conversion is the lowest step in the funnel at 60.9% with a mean time over 1000s, showing friction during pet picking.)
1: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Validation Safeguard Hint: Add a clear validation hint on the upload_photos screen specifying photo quality guidelines before processing. (why: Support received 3 tickets regarding custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly due to photo submission errors.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Two Column Sign In Safeguard Layout: Redesign the sign_in screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet data protection and cloud sync. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign_in account protection redesigns have proven effective.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Preparation Waiting Progress Component: Display an active progress indicator bar on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare. (why: The home waiting step has high median (201s) and mean (2336s) times, causing user drop-off when waiting without visual status.)
4: [finish, redesign] Centered Desk Setup Desktop Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen to a centered layout detailing clear instructions on pet controls and desktop visibility. (why: Support noted multiple complaints from users unsure how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Story Intro Path Selection Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight layout featuring an engaging mascot component and clear intro copy. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s, indicating initial confusion before choosing an onboarding path.)
6: [adoption, copy] Official Certificate Adoption Pledge Copy Update: Update headline and body on adoption_certificate to emphasize pet ownership commitment and smooth finalization. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (39.1% lost), requiring stronger motivation to complete adoption steps.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Notification Banner: Enable readiness notification triggers on the waiting screen to alert users when companion setup finishes. (why: Home wait median duration is 201s; keeping users informed prevents abandoning the app during background setup.)
8: [sign_in, hint] Multi Account Sync Prevention Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign_in screen urging users to sign in with their existing account to avoid account resets. (why: The single largest support category (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets due to signing in with secondary accounts.)
9: [finish, hint] Quick Pet Visibility & Hide Control Hint: Include a visible hint on home_intro explaining shortcut keys and mouse actions for pet visibility. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide or summon the desktop pet.)
